The likely cause: the app put a “Linked sessions now” status block in front of your words, so the prompt did not start with override. The override hook (override.grant) checks only the start of the prompt, and that part does not strip such blocks; the Opus ask does. Type it again on its own:

override 12h

If the status block lands in front again, it fails again. A real fix belongs in claude-settings: override.grant should strip system blocks first, as the Opus ask path already does. That is work in another repo, so it needs your OK.
